Qianlong Dynasty is a Chinese historical drama television series based on the novel The  Qianlong Emperor () by Eryue He about the life of the Qianlong Emperor of the Qing dynasty. The series was preceded by Yongzheng Dynasty (1997) and Kangxi Dynasty (2001), both of which were also based on Eryue He's novels.
